articles.title: As it happened: spacewalkers install space station’s eighth and final upgraded solar array
articles.summary: During Thursday’s spacewalk, the astronauts will install the eighth and final International Space Station Roll-Out Solar Array, or IROSA.

articles.title: Spacewalkers complete five-year effort to upgrade space station power supply
articles.summary: Spacewalking astronauts Joshua Kutryk and Anil Menon unfurled the last of eight new solar arrays outside the International Space Station Thursday, working through an unexpected power snag to complete a five-year upgrade designed to keep the orbiting laboratory running through its retirement in 2030.
